{
  "status": "ADVISORY",
  "observations": [
    "BrazilCo's BRL operating account (ACC-BR-OPER-01) is forecasted to have a T+1 shortfall of BRL 80,000 against the required minimum of BRL 1,500,000.",
    "The BrazilCo reserve account (ACC-BR-RES-01) holds BRL 2,450,000, which is sufficient to cover the shortfall while maintaining the post-transfer minimum reserve balance required by policy (BRL 1,800,000).",
    "A same-entity intragroup transfer of BRL 80,000 from ACC-BR-RES-01 to ACC-BR-OPER-01 would restore the operating account to the required T+1 minimum.",
    "Both accounts are approved, belong to BrazilCo, and are eligible for such a transfer under current treasury policy and authority envelope.",
    "The proposed transfer amount is below the autonomous execution threshold (BRL 100,000) and within the maximum permitted (BRL 1,000,000).",
    "No policy or data freshness conflicts are observed for this action."
  ]
}
